decision.rationale: The documented _links array triggers a parser exception and 500. The schema shape and unhandled conversion both need correction under §10.6; primary attribution follows the non-gateway 5xx rule.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: UserDTO inherits RepresentationModel; generic Exception.class handling at RestExceptionHandler:37–42 maps parser errors to 500. UserDTOReq _links is an array while named HAL objects are parsed. §10.6 is decisive regardless of absent independent intent.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
